Here's a regex for ISO 8601 calendar dates (`YYYY-MM-DD`):

```
^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01])$
```

- `\d{4}` matches the year.
- `(0[1-9]|1[0-2])` matches the month, 01–12.
- `(0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01])` matches the day, 01–31.

It matches `2026-10-01`. It checks the format and ranges only, so it also accepts impossible dates like `2026-02-31`. Checking those needs a date parser. To find dates inside longer text, replace `^` and `$` with `\b`.
